companyCode: Use letters, digits and hyphens only; it cannot start or end with a hyphen
password: Password needs 8+ characters with a lowercase letter (a-z) and a digit
taxId: Use digits, letters and hyphens only
totp: The code from the app has 6 digits
dateOrder: End date must not be before the start date
maxBelowMin: Maximum stock must not be below minimum stock
sameUnit: From and to unit must differ
